column1: # Rows db.ps15b2.tn.* (line PS, PS15b-2): tblastn -in_pssm (PSI-TBLASTN) with outfmt 12 to 16 and 18 against tests/db_search/tslice and -subject tests/db_search/tslice.fna, and a PSSM query of the molecule other (ps6c_other_iupacaa: NCBI searches it as a protein) in every format but 11: outfmt 0 writes NCBI's skipped-alignment line for each HSP, 1 to 4 a line feed as the section, 5, 15 and 16 the caught exception of the query's letters, 13 and 14 the uncaught exception (exit status 255), 6, 7, 10 and 20 the exception at the first row whose fields read the query's letters; NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 `tblastn ... -num_threads 1`.
